about: IK clip variants (tools/ik_clip.mjs; gen/details/contacts/fix_standard.md step 4): per variant, the ops that pin a clip's contact sites onto targets in the figure's root frame (x its left, y up, z forward, page metres). A character gets one as a clip source "ik:<base clip>@<variant>" in characters/<name>.json, under the clip name "<base clip>~<variant>". Targets are in the frame the page draws once the clip's ground offset (clip_meta sole_m, tools/clip_ground.mjs) is applied ("frame": "proposed", the default; "page": people.js today).
